title: Revenue Management in Hospitality Business
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of seminars/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of revenue management, strategic pricing, and the role of revenue management.
Analyze market segments, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization.
Apply pricing strategies in different scenarios.
Implement dynamic pricing based on fluctuating value.
Optimize revenue through strategic pricing and inventory management.
Manage revenue per available room effectively.
Understand legal and ethical issues related to pricing and revenue management.
Evaluate the effectiveness of revenue management strategies.
